result.reason: The redline appropriately narrows the restriction to the specified Deerskin-branded consumer website, limits it to the agreement term, preserves other channels and HDI’s related exclusivity, and includes product-development and acquisition carve-outs. However, it does not expressly cap the restriction at 12 months, so it could exceed the fallback if the agreement term is longer. The internal-development carve-out also covers development of products but does not clearly permit internal development of the restricted website itself.
